title: Theodosia Burr Alston Disappearance
hook: Who vanished with the ship that never returned?
headline: The Ship That Swallowed a Daughter

beats.label: THE CASE
beats.line: Theodosia Burr Alston sailed aboard the schooner Patriot on December 31, 1812.

beats.label: CLUE 1
beats.line: The ship sailed on December 31, 1812, heading toward Hatteras.

beats.label: CLUE 2
beats.line: Witnesses later reported seeing wreckage and a lone lifeboat drifting near Ocracoke Island.

beats.label: THE TWIST
beats.line: No bodies were recovered, and some letters suggest a possible kidnapping by a privateer.

end.line: What do you think really happened to Theodosia?

description: A quick look at the mysterious 1813 disappearance of Theodosia Burr Alston.
